description: Introducing the AOTG-CX3, a premium Type C to 3.5mm headphone jack (Aux) adapter designed for seamless audio connectivity. Featuring a built-in Audio DAC, this adapter ensures high-fidelity music reproduction with support for up to 48k Hz and 24-bit lossless output. Compatible with a wide range of devices, including the latest iPhone 15 Pro Max, Galaxy S23, and other Type C phones, as well as laptops, the AOTG-CX1 is perfect for all your audio needs. Its robust construction includes metal shells that resist oxidation and corrosion, and an unbreakable nylon braided cable that is twist, tug, and tangle-free. With support for both microphone and line control, this plug-and-play adapter offers convenience and exceptional audio quality.
